card.name: Screens, apps and online interfaces
card.fires_on: Words in web or computer-interface text where the next word could be a screen or software term, such as desktop, Facebook page, app, prompt, or click. It responds to small words like as, on, an, to just before such terms.

modes.description: A small word like as, on, an or to inside sentences about social media, TV screens or apps.

modes.description: Verbs inviting the reader to interact with a web page or on-screen display.
